name: Kami (Kōchi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kami city emblem in green, orange and blue: a green stylised figure with an orange head above blue waves.
history: Municipal flag of Kami, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2006.

features.role: Kami city emblem — a green stylised figure with an orange head above blue waves
